scientific_integrity: Analytic tight-incidence rank proof with exact integer transfer-polynomial calculation and independently formulated rational active-basis finite verification. The endpoint result of D’Alì–Delucchi–Michałek is cited as prior art.
scientific_limitations: Only real finite wheel metrics with at least four rim vertices and common spoke length strictly between one-half and one. Counts only facets of the Lipschitz-free unit ball; endpoint counts acknowledged as pre-existing. Independent mathematical validation not performed.
title: A four-letter facet law for short-spoked wheel metrics
